description: List your conversations and memories, newest first, with titles, dates, participants and duration. Filter by date range (from/to) and by a person who was in the conversation; page back through your whole history with the cursor the previous page returns.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page, to continue further back. Keep the same filters.

from.description: Earliest date to include: YYYY-MM-DD (the whole day in the user's time zone, as the app groups meetings) or an RFC 3339 time.

person.description: Only conversations with a participant whose name contains this (case-insensitive).

to.description: Latest date to include: YYYY-MM-DD (the whole day in the user's time zone, as the app groups meetings) or an RFC 3339 time.

name: list_memories
